references.text: The following text where Samson sings about his victory with the jawbone of a donkey, explaining the significance of this event
Shamgar also killed Philistines with an unconventional weapon (an oxgoad), showing a pattern of God's deliverance through unusual means
David defeated Goliath with a simple sling and stone, another example of victory with unconventional weapons by God's power
A single warrior who struck down many enemies by the Lord's hand, similar to Samson's feat
The book of Hebrews mentions the judges, including Samson, who through faith defeated enemies and became mighty in battle
